# Idea

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

An idea about something to explore curiosity, research interests, support areas, or identify opportunities.

## Scope note

Framed as a distillation from a Spark, Concept, or Interest, and explicitly distinguished from Focus (priority flag, not a content type).
